# GyanArt — Comprehensive LLM Documentation

> Complete business profile, service offerings, methodology, pricing, and entity data for GyanArt (Bengaluru, India).

## About GyanArt

GyanArt is an independent digital growth consultancy and web design studio founded and led by Gyaneshwar, a UX designer with more than 20 years of experience. GyanArt specializes in helping small, owner-operated businesses and professional services in Bangalore establish a credible, high-converting digital presence.

Instead of generic website templates or vanity traffic campaigns, GyanArt focuses on the complete customer enquiry journey:
1. **Get Found:** Local SEO foundations, Google Business Profile optimization, and accurate area-served targeting.
2. **Get Chosen:** Clear visual hierarchy, transparent pricing, genuine credentials, and mobile usability that builds immediate trust.
3. **Get Contacted:** Direct, low-friction next actions—predominantly phone calls and WhatsApp messaging, aligned with local Indian consumer behavior.
4. **Get Better:** Continuous measurement, review management, and monthly performance tuning.

---

## Detailed Service Catalog

### 1. Website Design & Development
- **URL:** https://www.gyanart.com/website-design.html
- **Target Audience:** Small business owners, clinics, independent consultants, local retailers in Bangalore.
- **Technologies:** Semantic HTML5, lightweight modern CSS, performant JavaScript, custom WordPress (block-based, zero page-builder bloat), Shopify/WooCommerce e-commerce.
- **Key Features:** Mobile-first layout, Core Web Vitals optimization, accessible color contrast, click-to-call & WhatsApp integration, Schema.org structured data, XML sitemaps, Google Search Console & Analytics integration.
- **Timeline:** 2 to 3 weeks for standard 5 to 10-page websites.

### 2. Local SEO Services
- **URL:** https://www.gyanart.com/local-seo-services.html
- **Focus:** Ranking for high-intent local searches across Bangalore neighborhoods (e.g., Whitefield, Varthur, HSR Layout, Koramangala).
- **Deliverables:** On-page localization, service-area alignment, title/meta tag tuning, internal linking structure, and local business citation consistency.

### 3. Google Business Profile (GBP) Optimization
- **URL:** https://www.gyanart.com/google-business-profile-optimization.html
- **Focus:** Google Maps and Local 3-Pack visibility.
- **Deliverables:** Primary category selection, verified pin placement, operating hours, comprehensive service listings, photo audit, and ethical review response strategy.

### 4. Logo & Visual Identity Design
- **URL:** https://www.gyanart.com/logo-design.html
- **Deliverables:** Functional logos for digital screens, WhatsApp profiles, Google Business profiles, and local signage.

## Transparent Pricing Tiers

All packages include full responsive design, semantic code, search readiness, and direct collaboration with the founder.

| Package | One-Time Fee | Scope | Best For |
|:---|:---:|:---|:---|
| **Digital Foundation** | ₹10,000 | Up to 5 standard pages, responsive mobile layout, WhatsApp/call CTA, GBP setup basics | Solo professionals & early-stage local shops |
| **Enquiry Builder** | ₹25,000 | Up to 10 pages, custom visual styling, conversion-focused page layout, enquiry tracking | Established local businesses seeking more leads |
| **Growth Optimization** | ₹37,000 | Up to 30 pages, custom service structure, deeper analytics & search measurement | Larger practices, clinics & multi-service firms |
| **Monthly Support** | ₹1,000 – ₹3,000 / mo | Technical maintenance, content updates, and Local SEO monitoring | Continuous improvement post-launch |

## Geographic Service Area (Bangalore Localities)

GyanArt primarily serves businesses located in and around:
- **East Bangalore & Local Studio Base:** Varthur, Balagere, Marathahalli, Whitefield, Bellandur, Kadubeesanahalli, Sarjapur Road.
- **South & Central Bangalore Startup Corridors:** HSR Layout, Koramangala, Indiranagar, BTM Layout, Jayanagar.
- **Dedicated Suburb Corridor Hubs:**
  - [Whitefield & Varthur Web Design](https://www.gyanart.com/website-design-whitefield.html): Website design, speed optimization, and local SEO for IT consultancies, clinics, and businesses near ITPL, Hope Farm, and Balagere.
  - [HSR Layout & Koramangala Web Design](https://www.gyanart.com/website-design-hsr-layout.html): Conversion-focused website design, landing pages, and UX strategy for startups and businesses in HSR Layout and Koramangala.
